description: Phobius false signal-peptide rate on human type II signal anchors, stratified by cytoplasmic tail length
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd from scipy import stats as sstat import matplotlib.pyplot as plt def phob(d,chunk=40): out={}; items=list(d.items()) for i in range(0,len(items),chunk): fa="".join(f">{k}\n{v}\n" for k,v in items[i:i+chunk]) r=requests.post("https://phobius.sbc.su.se/cgi-bin/predict.pl",files={'protseq':(None,fa),'format':(None,'short')},timeout=90) m=re.search(r"
(.*?)
",r.text,re.S) if not m: continue for line in m.group(1).strip().split("\n")[1:]: p=line.split() if len(p)>=4: out[p[0]]=(int(p[1]),p[2]) return out sa=requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=(organism_id:9606)+AND+(reviewed:true)+AND+(ft_transmem:"Signal-anchor+for+type+II+membrane+protein")&fields=accession,ft_transmem,sequence&format=json',timeout=300).json()["results"] short={}; long_={} for e in sa: sq=e["sequence"]["value"] tms=[f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transmembrane" and "Signal-anchor" in f.get("description","")] if not tms or len(sq)<=60: continue (short if tms[0]["location"]["start"]["value"]<=15 else long_)[e["primaryAccession"]]=sq[:120] long_=dict(list(long_.items())[:175]) rs=phob(short); rl=phob(long_) ks=sum(v[1]=="Y" for v in rs.values()); kl=sum(v[1]=="Y" for v in rl.values()) fs,fl=100*ks/len(rs),100*kl/len(rl) orr,pf=sstat.fisher_exact([[ks,len(rs)-ks],[kl,len(rl)-kl]]) print(f"TM start <=15 (AADACL2-like): Phobius calls cleaved SP in {ks}/{len(rs)} = {fs:.1f}%") print(f"TM start >15 : Phobius calls cleaved SP in {kl}/{len(rl)} = {fl:.1f}%") print(f"Fisher OR={orr:.2f} p={pf:.3e}") fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4.2)) ax.bar([0,1],[fs,fl],color=["#c0392b","#2980b9"],width=.55) ax.text(0,fs+1.2,f"{ks}/{len(rs)}",ha="center"); ax.text(1,fl+1.2,f"{kl}/{len(rl)}",ha="center") ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["TM start $\\leq$15 aa\n(AADACL2-like)","TM start >15 aa"]) ax.set_ylabel("Phobius calls a cleaved signal peptide (%)") ax.set_title(f"Phobius false signal-peptide rate on human type II signal anchors\nFisher p = {pf:.1e}") ax.set_ylim(0,max(fs,fl)*1.35); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show() pd.DataFrame({"stratum":["TM_start<=15","TM_start>15"],"n":[len(rs),len(rl)], "phobius_called_SP":[ks,kl],"pct":[fs,fl]}).to_csv("phobius_false_SP_rate_type2_anchors.csv",index=False) print("saved phobius_false_SP_rate_type2_anchors.csv")
